title: Self-check
description: The model's own pass over the task it wrote, handed in together with it. It is one of the reasons a task can be refused, and the only one that can see an ambiguity.

issues.description: Every defect found, and an empty list when there is none.

severity.description: blocking refuses the task; minor keeps it and the remark is kept with it.

option_check.description: Why each of the five options is right or wrong, one pass over all of them.

final_answer.description: The answer the model arrives at when it solves its own task afresh, or UNSOLVABLE when it cannot be solved as written.
